$comment: drain.asyncShadow: 'shadow' or 'off'. Read-only async-drain enqueue timing observation (R425; it never changes admission or enqueue decisions). Resolve explicit createAsyncShadow mode option, then WE_ASYNC_DRAIN (off|shadow), then this tool setting; a set but invalid env value, an invalid setting or no value means off. Shadow writes bounded rows (1 MB, 24 h retention) under <coordination>/drain-async-shadow/. Set to off to opt out.
